Custom Sensory Iconography (Self-Made SVG Emoji Replacements)

Calm, Cohesive & Neurodivergent-Friendly Vector Glyphs

Standard OS Unicode emojis (Apple, Samsung, Google) render with chaotic color clashes, sharp angles, and jarring realism that trigger sensory friction for neurodivergent wearers. This bespoke icon library replaces erratic system emojis with handcrafted, soothing vector shapes built strictly on BioCue's 24×24 grid, with 2px rounded strokes, gentle curved apertures, and zero alarming visual cues.

✓ 24×24dp Pixel Grid ✓ 2px Rounded Strokes ✓ Live DLS Theme Responsive (currentColor) ✓ Zero-Anxiety Non-Aggressive Shapes
🌱 1. Wearer Sensory & Bio-Signal States
Replaces 🌿 & ✨
icon-calm

Tranquil twin sprout of equilibrium. Conveys nervous system regulation, resting baseline, and grounded safety.

Token: state.calm.ink on state.calm.soft
Replaces 🌩️
icon-overwhelmed

Gentle sensory cloud with undulating rhythmic ripples. Eliminates the violent, fear-inducing lightning bolt while honoring heightened sensory surge.

Token: state.alert.ink on state.alert.soft
Replaces ✨
icon-excited

Organic 4-point rounded spark with satellite orbs. Denotes positive arousal, joyful stimulation, flow state, and intense special interests.

Token: state.rising.ink on state.rising.soft
Replaces 🏃
icon-active

Kinetic rhythm glyph. Represents heart rate elevation driven by healthy physical movement, walking, exercise, or vestibular stimming.

Token: state.info.ink on state.info.soft
Replaces 🧠
icon-brain

BioCue central brand emblem. Symmetric dual-hemisphere cerebral contour honoring neurodiversity, bio-signals, and inner balance.

Token: action.primary / action.onPrimary
🔊 2. Environmental & Context Triggers (Pattern Review)
Replaces 🔊
icon-loud-noises

Acoustic horn with twin soundwave ripples. Denotes decibel spikes, sensory acoustic overload, sirens, or crowded dining rooms.

EventTypes.CONTEXT_LOUD_NOISES
Replaces 👥
icon-crowded

Intertwined rounded human silhouettes. Denotes dense social spaces, supermarkets, public transit, and personal-space boundary strain.

EventTypes.CONTEXT_CROWDED
Replaces 📋
icon-task-demand

Calm rounded clipboard with soft checklist lines. Indicates high cognitive executive demand, schoolwork, tests, or workplace deadlines.

EventTypes.CONTEXT_DEMAND
Replaces 🔄
icon-routine-change

Infinite orbital loop arrows. Denotes unexpected schedule interruptions, route detours, delayed trains, or transition disorientation.

EventTypes.CONTEXT_ROUTINE
Replaces 🤷
icon-unknown-context

Smooth circular query glyph. Selected when the caregiver was not present or the environmental trigger could not be determined.

EventTypes.CONTEXT_UNKNOWN
🔒 3. Care Circle, Privacy & Grounding Tools
Replaces 👤 & 🧑‍⚕️
icon-caregiver

Serene person avatar with supportive base. Used across circle lists, approvals, and caregiver cards (always paired with the person's name).

Component: EmojiAvatar
Replaces 🌿 & 🔊 (Audio)
icon-soothing-audio

Calming soundwave envelope inside a protective botanical contour. The 1-tap sensory grounding audio tool on the wearer home hero.

Action: onToggleCalmAudio
Replaces 🔒
icon-privacy-lock

Arched geometric padlock. Guarantees that raw biometric data (HR, HRV, motion) never leaves the local watch and companion phone.

Component: PrivacyRow
Replaces 📍
icon-sos-location

Beacon map pin with inner pulse dot. Disclosed only during emergency SOS events, kept in volatile memory only.

Component: SosAlertCard
Replaces 🔗
icon-pairing-link

Two interlocking rounded chain loops. Represents mutual caregiver pairing and consent-governed connection.

Screen: PairingScreen
Replaces 📤
icon-telemetry-sync

Secure upward telemetry transfer arrow. Represents syncing categorized stress event boundaries to approved caregivers.

Component: PrivacyRow

Rules

  • Calm, not clinical. No live vitals are ever shown. Colour carries meaning (calm · rising · support); numbers and percentages do not.
  • Support is coral, never alarming red. State.alert is a warm coral. Red-alarm styling, flashing and sirens are not part of this language.
  • Touch targets. Every tappable thing is at least 48 × 48 (dp / pt). A 40-point visual circle sits inside a 48-point hit area.
  • Identity is the name. Show a person's name — never an email address — on every screen of every app.
  • Semantic tokens only. Components read tokens such as surface.card or text.primary. Raw hex values and palette names are not allowed in components.
  • Ink on soft is for large text. state.*.ink on state.*.soft meets 3:1 (titles). Body text on a soft surface uses text.primary (4.5:1).
  • Muted is decorative. text.muted is for captions that carry no essential information (see the contrast table warning).
  • Motion is short. 150–400 ms with the standard easing; honour reduced-motion; nothing loops.

Reskinning

  1. Duplicate a theme in design/dls.tokens.json and change its values.
  2. Run python3 tools/gen_dls.py --theme <name> — it refuses an incomplete theme or a failing contrast pair.
  3. Open this page and switch themes to review every component.
  4. Rebuild the apps. No component code changes.
